title: Mermaid
hero_prompt: A hand-drawn technical blueprint diagram in indigo ink on cream paper: a lone draftsman at a slanted drafting table tracing a flowchart that branches like a river delta into node-pools, each fork redrawn cleanly rather than erased, fine technical pen linework, blueprint-diagram style.
icon_prompt: Square bold emblem: a single thick black diamond-node bent into a right-angle flowchart arrow, indigo on cream, blueprint style reduced to bold high-contrast shapes, no fine linework.
